description: Erection of a single-storey rear extension to the side and rear of the existing back addition; alterations to the roof of the ground-floor rear back addition; erection of a single-storey outbuilding in the rear garden; and installation of an air conditioning unit within an acoustic enclosure in the rear garden.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

P-2B
P-4B
P-6B
P-8B
P-9B
FRA
Environmental Noise Assessment, by Clear Acoustic Design Ltd, 27 Althea Street, London, Report Ref: CAD-26033, dated 18 May 2026.

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls Extension: Yellow London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.  

- Walls Outbuilding: Wood cladding

- Windows: uPVC sash

- Doors: Aluminium frame

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - No part of any roof of the extensions and outbuilding hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).  
Condition : 5 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extension and outbuilding hereby permitted.

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment  prepared by Bashtan Construction Rev A, dated 18 August 2026. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 7 - The outbuilding located in the rear garden hereby approved shall only be used in connection with, and ancillary to, the use of the dwellinghouse. In particular the outbuilding shall not be occupied as a self-contained unit  that is separate and distinct from the use of the property as a residential dwelling.   

The use of the outbuilding as a self-contained unit, separate from the use of the property as a dwelling, would raise materially different planning considerations that the Council would wish to consider under a full planning application , in accordance with Policies HO1, T4, CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 8 - The external sound level emitted from air conditioning unit at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the lowest existing background sound level by at least 10dBA in order to prevent any adverse impact. The assessment shall be made in accordance with BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.
Condition : 9 - Prior to use, the air conditioning unit at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such.

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration, in accordance with Policies CC11 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.
